scope: Non-tree control proving that sign-valued edge defects are removable exactly when every graph-cycle product is plus one.

general_theorem.connected_graph_condition: beta_uv = epsilon_u epsilon_v has a solution iff the product of beta over every cycle is plus_one
general_theorem.necessity: vertex signs occur twice in every cycle product
general_theorem.sufficiency: propagate signs on a spanning tree; cycle products make every chord consistent

claim_ceiling: Exact Z2 graph-cochain obstruction with a triangle countercontrol. D7's simple graph has no such cycle; general Coxeter presentation cocycles and analytic intertwiner monodromy remain outside scope.
